bio: Delivering high-performance React Native and React applications across enterprise and healthcare domains. Expert in offline-first architecture, complex BLE integrations, and high-scale component libraries.

projects.title: RAG Document Assistant & Chat Interface
projects.summary: React Native / Electron chat interfaces and a source-validation viewer for a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline, cutting document review from hours to under 2 minutes per 1,000+ pages.
body: Built the client surface for a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) document assistant: conversational chat interfaces shipped on React Native and Electron, backed by a source-validation viewer that lets reviewers jump from an answer straight to the passage it was grounded in.
The result turned a multi-hour manual review process into a guided, verifiable workflow — under 2 minutes per 1,000+ pages.

projects.title: Enterprise Shared Component Library
projects.summary: Architected a shared React Native component library from Figma designs, adopted by 10+ production apps and 10 engineering teams.
body: Translated a Figma design system into a typed, themeable React Native component library that became the shared UI foundation across the organisation.
Adoption spread to 10+ production apps and 10 engineering teams, unifying visual language and removing duplicated UI work across product lines.

projects.title: Offline-First Secure Mobile Core
projects.summary: Network-resilient mobile architecture featuring encrypted SQLite, biometric auth, and centralized state management to prevent data loss.
metrics: Zero data loss on network drop
body: Designed an offline-first core for field-ready mobile apps: an encrypted SQLite persistence layer, biometric authentication, and centralized state management that keeps work safe through flaky or absent connectivity.
The architecture treats the network as optional, so user data is never lost between sync windows.

projects.title: BLE Healthcare Monitoring Platform
projects.summary: Patient- and CRA-facing iOS apps interfacing with medical hardware over Bluetooth LE, with Secure Connections and custom Swift native modules for HIPAA compliance.
body: Engineered patient-facing and clinical research associate (CRA)-facing iOS applications that communicate with medical monitoring hardware over Bluetooth Low Energy.
Implemented BLE Secure Connections pairing and wrote custom Swift native modules bridged into React Native to meet HIPAA requirements end to end.

projects.title: Serverless Telemedicine Platform
projects.summary: A serverless React Native telehealth ecosystem with real-time patient/provider scheduling and clinical workflows.
body: Engineered a serverless telehealth ecosystem with React Native clients and an AWS backend, supporting real-time scheduling between patients and providers and the workflows around each visit.
